products.name: HPE ProLiant Compute DL360 Gen12
products.summary: Compact 1U dual-socket Intel Xeon 6 server with up to 144 cores per processor, up to 8 TB of memory and 20 E3.S NVMe drives.
products.description: The HPE ProLiant Compute DL360 Gen12 is a 1U two-processor server powered by Intel Xeon 6 processors with up to 144 cores, supporting up to 8 TB of memory and up to 20 EDSFF E3.S NVMe drives. A hybrid front storage cage also supports SFF drives, an OS boot device and optional front OCP NICs. HPE sells it from a starting configuration on the HPE Store.
products.keywords: hpe proliant dl360 gen12 1u xeon 6 rack server ilo 7
